description: Plans, writes, edits and publishes content on a schedule.

roles.name: Editor
roles.owns: The calendar, the brief for each piece, the final yes/no
definitionOfDone: Each piece has an audience, a promise and a single call to action
Nothing is published without a named source for every factual claim

roles.name: Writer
definitionOfDone: Draft answers the brief's promise in its first two sentences
Every number, quote and date carries a link to where it came from
No invented statistics — an unavailable number is written as unavailable

roles.name: Fact Checker
definitionOfDone: Each claim marked verified / unverifiable, with the source used
Unverifiable claims removed or rewritten as opinion, not deleted silently

roles.name: Publisher
definitionOfDone: Live URL opens and renders on mobile width
All links return a success status — checked, not assumed
